objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: All provenance-bearing filenames and metadata use gemini-3.5-flash-lite exactly.
Audit schema distinguishes KEEP_ACTIVE, CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY, and UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE or equivalent conservative states.
Active project/repository directories are never recommended for removal.
provenance_match is true only on actual exact ledger/provenance matches.
PowerShell audit script has no delete/uninstall/registry-write/service-stop/package-removal commands and does not modify candidate files.
Default script behavior emits JSON to stdout; optional report-file write requires explicit output-path input.
Astra review packet contains objective, artifacts, evidence, risks, open questions, and explicit approval/rejection criteria and remains pending.
CURRENT_STATE records Google Drive and configured GitHub Actions Gemini secret status without secret values.
Memory records TASK-0001 as awaiting Astra review.
retry_reason: Pre-Astra safety/provenance gate found issues in the previous candidate. Regenerate the audit package with the corrections below before spending Astra reviewer usage.
orchestrator_corrections: Use the exact actual worker model identifier gemini-3.5-flash-lite in every provenance field and provenance-bearing filename. Do not claim gemini-3-flash-preview.
Do not mark active repository/project directories such as .git, memory, tasks, docs, or the orchestrator workspace as cleanup candidates or safe to remove. They must be KEEP_ACTIVE or excluded.
Do not set provenance_match=true or add a provenance_registry_match evidence signal unless an exact candidate path was actually matched to a provenance/installation ledger entry.
Unknown, user, Windows/system, driver, application, registry, and unrelated paths must default to UNSAFE_DO_NOT_REMOVE / UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE.

The audit script must be non-destructive. It may read metadata. By default it should emit JSON to stdout. Writing a report file may happen only when the user explicitly supplies an output path; the script must never delete, uninstall, stop services, modify registry, or alter candidate files.

The audit script should scan only explicitly supplied candidate roots plus narrowly defined known agent-owned roots. It must not recursively scan the entire system drive or arbitrary user home by default.
Separate active project artifacts from removable candidates in the schema/status model.
Update CURRENT_STATE to persistent_storage_provider=GOOGLE_DRIVE and GEMINI secret status=CONFIGURED_GITHUB_ACTIONS_SECRET without exposing the secret.
Update NEXT_ACTIONS to remove already-completed manual Gemini-key and storage-provider steps.
The Astra review packet must clearly say PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW and must not claim approval.
